title: Link a computer
summary: Signs a browser in to the account by QR code (MSC4108, ADR 0116, ADR 0118). chat.bipe.net.br shows the code; this phone scans it from Aparelhos conectados only, then shows the full-access warning, waits through the cooldown, asks for a biometric check, shows the check code, and approves in a private web view of the MAS consent page.

ip.description: The browser IP read from the MAS consent page text.

place.description: City and region from GET /v1/web-link/place, country added when abroad. Absent: unknown.

phase.description: scanning: camera open. connecting: the secure channel forms. warning: the full-access text. cooldown: the continue button counts down. confirmOwner: the biometric check. checkCode: the 2-digit code to type on the computer. consent: the private web view with the MAS page. finishing: secrets sync and the server cleans up.

cooldownLeft.description: Seconds left before Continue works. Starts at webLinkCooldownSeconds (registries/accounts.json).

checkCode.description: check_code_string of the EstablishingSecureChannel progress, 2 digits.

startedAt.description: When the scan started. Sent to POST /v1/web-link/finish.

error.description: Why failed: from HumanQrGrantLoginError, the QR decode, or the web view (signInPage: MAS showed its login form a second time).

bytes.description: The QR code payload, as bytes from the camera.

scan.effect: QrCodeData.fromBytes. A code whose serverName or baseUrl is not Bipe's homeserver, or whose intent is not a new device asking to log in, sets error notBipeCode. Else GrantLoginWithQrCodeHandler.scan with a progress listener; phase connecting.

step.description: GrantQrLoginProgress: starting, establishingSecureChannel, waitingForAuth, syncingSecrets, done.

progress.effect: establishingSecureChannel: keeps checkCode and shows warning (the code shows only after the biometric check). waitingForAuth: keeps verification_uri and the continuation sender for consent. syncingSecrets: finishing. done: runs finish.

continue.effect: From warning when cooldownLeft is 0 (warning haptic when the warning shows): confirmOwner with bipe_link_computer_biometric. A passed check reads the hidden password from the credential store and shows checkCode.

codeTyped.effect: The person says the computer took the code (or the progress moves to waitingForAuth): opens consent. The web view loads verification_uri on the MAS host only, fills the MAS login form once with the localpart and the hidden password, and shows bipe_link_computer_consent_hint with the browser IP and place above the page.

approved.effect: When the web view leaves the consent page after the approve, or the person closes it: ContinuationMessageSender.confirm, clears the web view's cookies, then waits for done.

finish.effect: POST /v1/web-link/finish with startedAt, so the MAS browser sessions the web view made end. Shows bipe_link_computer_done with the success haptic and goes back to linked-devices.

cancel.effect: At any step: GrantLoginWithQrCodeTask.cancel (or ContinuationMessageSender.cancel in consent), clears the web view, phase cancelled.

notes: Direction (ADR 0116): the browser shows the code, the phone scans. This is the one exception to the ADR 0059 rule; phone-to-phone keeps the other direction. The scanner opens only from linked-devices: the general camera, attachments, links and a QR code in a message never start it (rule 5).

Support gate (ADR 0118): Client.isLoginWithQrCodeSupported needs an OAuth session, and Bipe signs in with m.login.password, so it says no. Use Bipe's check instead: /versions advertises org.matrix.msc4108 and this phone holds the hidden password of a device-first account. Then call GrantLoginWithQrCodeHandler.scan; no SDK patch.

SDK vs server: the SDK gives the MSC4108 channel, the check code, the verification URI and secrets sync (cross-signing and the backup key, so the browser decrypts history itself). Server and Bipe work outside the SDK: the MAS device code consent page needs a MAS browser session, which only the private web view makes with the form fill (bipe/docs/security.md QR finding: both directions need the consent page on the signed-in device); the browser place (GET /v1/web-link/place, GeoIP on the Bipe server, no IP leaves Brazil); the clean-up of MAS browser sessions (POST /v1/web-link/finish).

Unverified: that GrantLoginWithQrCodeHandler.scan works for a session that signed in with m.login.password (the forks do the same, untested end to end, bipe/docs/security.md); that the SDK pin passes verification_uri_complete so MAS fills in the user code (ADR 0118, bipe-chat/bipe#392). If not, the consent page asks for the code shown on the computer.

Order (ADR 0118): warning, cooldown, biometric, then the web view. The SDK's check code is a step the ADR does not name: show it after the biometric check, so a person talked through the flow by a scammer meets the warning first.

Web view: iOS WKWebView with a non-persistent data store; Android a WebView in the app process. Never ASWebAuthenticationSession, SFSafariViewController or a Custom Tab. Loads only the MAS host. Fills the login form once; a second login form is error signInPage. Never logs or keeps the password.
The web device is unattested (ADR 0043). The warning haptic plays with the warning (use web_link_warning), success with done.

Bipe logic: BipeWebLink (localpart, isAllowed, isDeviceConsentPath, firstIPAddress, qrLoginFeature), BipeWebLinkPlace.label, BipeMatrixAccountAPI.supportsQRLogin and authMetadata, BipeAPIClient.webLinkPlace and finishWebLink (iOS); BipeWebLink, BipeWebLinkSession, BipeWebApprovalController, BipeMatrixAccountApi, BipeApiClient.webLinkPlace and finishWebLink (Android weblink/). Move them.
bipe_pause_countdown shows the cooldown on the Continue button; with reduced motion only the number changes.
